description: The project-centered workspace (M1): reads of projects, workspaces and sessions, one closed command envelope for every change, one native folder dialog (a folder returns a one-use token, never a path), the migration preview and its commit, the exclusive terminal input claim with checked terminal reads and writes, and the release gate. None takes a path, a command line, an environment, a prompt or a credential. Everything but the reads answers `unsupported_capability` until the owner turns the workspace on in a native confirmation window. Windows opened by it carry only this capability.
